g.title: cluster_pair
g.text: A vs B (RQ0a, RQ2, RQ3, RQ5a, RQ8b, RQ9b)

g.title: lg
g.text: or task × model × regime × split × metric

g.title: cs
g.text: CS1–CS15: one method (--case-method) vs its controls,
alternatives and long-series generators; row-level tests: predictions
averaged over seeds, ΔAUC on identical rows, block bootstrap by week

g.title: rk
g.text: rank methods per (dataset, seed) in every leaf
leaf → group → criterion × slice → domain → ranking
(equal weights per level; thematic slices; domain ranks)
4 rankings: fidelity val+OOT | train × utility clf | reg
privacy, cost separately; + cost as third domain, Pareto

g.title: nz
g.text: = smallest effect of interest (per dataset, unit)

g.title: co
g.text: Friedman per metric (discriminative?) · Spearman ρ within a dataset
across methods (metric ↔ metric, fidelity ↔ utility, descriptor ↔ effect)
→ median ρ, Wilcoxon over datasets, BH

g.title: cf
g.text: cells: U2.1 AUC and U2.6 (h = 24) MASE · TSTR · linear · OOT
C1 methods differ · C2 Diffusion-TS, Chronos vs assembly median
C3 selection main effect · C4 seam-processing main effect

g.title: ru
g.text: two-level bootstrap of ranks: CI, P(first), P(top 3)
Friedman · each method vs the best: Wilcoxon, Holm (tier)
Kendall τ between slices · Dirichlet weights · noise-pair check

g.title: pd
g.text: d = orientation · (A − B) on matching seeds; d > 0 ⇔ A better
B: a method, the assembly median, or a contrast

g.title: ds
g.text: per dataset (10 seeds): two one-sided Wilcoxon (α/2),

g.title: gl
g.text: global (9 datasets): d / noise → Wilcoxon · sign · t-test
TOST ±1 · two-level bootstrap CI; BH within question
